My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263),
I send the papers about [Sandwell](/organisation/12), and a back number of the [M P](/periodical/52), which please return. I have scarcely heard anything about the institution since I received this account from [Miss Goodrich](/person/567) so my knowledge of it is two years old[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Envelope addressed to Miss Ann Smith/ Rectory/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester (date torn) and London SE 7 March 1861.
[^2]: This letter identifies the A.M.G. who published \'Sandwell\' in MP (March 1859) 330-334, as Miss A. M.

Goodrich.
